metadata.scope: Locally built unmodified, CC-BY-4.0-authorized MetaLoc passinst instruments a fixed isolated LLVM TailCallElim source, which is then compiled into a new opt. Installed check executes both delivered Linux x86_64 binaries, verifies exact generated source, detects the original author counterexample and passes a no-op-module negative control. Includes verified selected LLVM source, all 40 original Cargo crates and separately delivered fixed Rust build inputs for offline reconstruction. No full MetaLoc campaign, other-pass, target-backend or cross-platform qualification.
